description: Verify that DUT TCP acknowledges a full-sized segment within 0.5 sec (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.2 p96 — When to Send an ACK Segment)
approach:
[Objective]
Full-sized segments must be acked promptly to keep the sender's window open. RFC 1122 §4.2.3.2 sets the deadline at 0.5 s.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: full-sized data segment (= DUT_MSS bytes).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK within 500 ms.

[Pass condition]
DUT ACK arrives within 500 ms of the data.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_data_ack_within_500ms — DUT did not ack within 500 ms

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked full-sized segment within 500 ms — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_data_ack_within_500ms: DUT did not ack full-sized segment within 500 ms
